psychological_meaning: San Felix, a deep forest green, evokes feelings of tranquility, growth, and connection to nature. It promotes a sense of stability and endurance, reminding us of the enduring strength and restorative power found in the natural world. This color can inspire feelings of hope, renewal, and a grounded sense of well-being.
